g.text: ① The window doing the writing — renderer process
③ Main process — the only side that may touch the disk
⑤ Every other window on the same project — renderer process
⑥ Anything else writing the same file

p.em: They are not the app's own colours.
Numbers are the order things happen.

div.p:
1. CodeMirror
sourceExtensions update listener
calls docText with the state's
OWN line separator

2. Drafts
change -> text only.
save -> only if dirty or diverged,
one write in flight per path

2'. CommandHub
the same save can arrive from
the native menu instead of
the Save button

12. NoteStore.settle
bumps the per-path ticket, drops
failures, installs the written bytes
without waiting for the watcher

13. Everything derived
Note prose · Sidebar dots and
gauges · StatusBar contentions
and unsaved · Rail backlinks

12'. Source conflict banner
two buttons, no merge:
discard and reload ·
overwrite the other change

3. createApi
writeFile(input) · readFile(path)
onCommand · onProjectEvent
casts every reply, validates nothing

0. Save menu item
CmdS -> send(focusedId, {kind:'save'})
over app:command

4. writeFileInput
relative path, no .. segment,
no backslash, no NUL,
text and baseSha bounded

5. locate + realInside
inside root -> is an agent file or
under wiki/journal -> realpath both
-> inside root again

6. serialised
module-level queue keyed on the
REAL path: two windows saving the
same file chain, never race

7. currentSha compare
sha256 of the bytes on disk vs the
draft's baseSha.
Empty sha means "did not exist"

8. writeAtomic
dot-prefixed temp file with a UUID
in the same directory,
then rename over the target

10. watchProject (chokidar)
one per project dir, shared by every
window on it. Dot paths ignored,
100 ms write-settle

11. projectEventFor + broadcast
addressed by directory:
registry.windowsOn(dir),
including the writer

9a. .name.UUID.tmp
same directory, so the rename is
atomic. Invisible to the watcher
because it is a dot path

9b. The wiki file
UTF-8, byte-for-byte: BOM, CRLF and
a missing trailing newline all
survive the round trip

NoteStore
re-reads over file:read if the path
is still in its list, ticket-guarded.
Prose re-renders

editState
a draft here becomes stale
(nothing typed) or diverged
(something typed). Editor text untouched

The agent in the drawer,
or any other editor
writes the target directly.
Outside the app's own queue
